extDescription.message: Dims low-view videos and tiny channels in YouTube recommendations, and skips Shorts nobody liked.

statusNotYouTube.message: Open YouTube to see it at work

exemptSubscriptions.message: Never touch channels I'm subscribed to

homeShortsHint.message: Removes Shorts shelves from the home page

shortsHint.message: Covers and mutes Shorts with fewer than {n} likes

skipHiddenLikes.message: Also skip Shorts that hide their likes

badgeHint.message: How many videos are filtered in the tab

clearCacheHint.message: Subscriber counts are kept for a week. This forgets them.

clearCacheDone.message: Done. Counts reload as you browse.

aiIntroText.message: Chrome's built-in AI reads the video's transcript and tells you what it is about, so you know before you spend twenty minutes. It runs on your computer and sends nothing anywhere.

aiIntroDownload.message: The first time, Chrome downloads its AI model. It is a few gigabytes and happens once.

aiUnsupported.message: This browser has no built-in AI, so summaries are not available here yet. Support for other AI services is on the way.

aiNeedsDownload.message: Chrome needs to download its AI model once. It is a few gigabytes.

errNoTranscript.message: This video has no transcript, so there is nothing to summarize.

errFailed.message: Could not read the transcript. Reload the YouTube page and try again.

errModel.message: The AI could not answer. Try again.

notVideo.message: Open a video on YouTube to see its summary here.

aiSettingsHint.message: A short AI summary of the video in this popup

aiAutoTitle.message: Summarize when I open the popup

aiPromptHint.message: Sent together with the video's transcript. Leave empty to use the default.

aiLanguageNote.message: Chrome's built-in AI writes only in these languages, so for your browser language the summary is in English.
